source_worktree_status: clean for file.h and file.cpp; original repository not modified
license: First-party permission; no separate copyright/license header in the adapted source. Project outbound license remains pending.
extraction: Focused FILE ownership and POSIX 64-bit seek/tell adaptation. The Windows adapter reuses this project's atomic_storage HANDLE ownership because CRT file handles did not support the required replacement behavior.
modifications: Read-only shared file/range value handles with checked offsets, serialized cursor I/O and bounded caller-owned buffers
Google naming, initialized members, pimpl and no public native pointers
No px DataPtr, logging, string utilities, async or network dependencies
Existing FFmpeg LocalInput accepts file ranges through its 32 KiB custom AVIO buffer
Windows atomic replacement uses FileRenameInfoEx POSIX semantics after access-denied MoveFileEx; no delete-then-move fallback
validation: Windows and USB Android 32 MiB ranges, concurrent readers, retained old file after atomic replacement, exact FFmpeg PCM from a ranged source larger than 16 MiB, precise seek and cancellation. Container/Player integration follows separately.
